_comment: Part id -> real KiCad 7 footprint and how our logical pins map to its pad names. Default: pad name = the part's `number`. Every row is cross-checked by tests/test_board_layout_footprints.py against the footprint file and, where KiCad has one, the symbol library.

esp32.note: Pad 39 is the exposed ground pad under the module; it joins the ground net with GND3.

ldo33.note: Generic 3-pin LDO: VIN=1, GND=2, VOUT=3. Choose a regulator whose SOT-23 pinout matches this map or edit the map.

usbc.note: Power-only use: no D+/D-. Both CC pins are available for the 5.1 k pull-downs.

led.note: KiCad numbers the cathode as pad 1 and the anode as pad 2.
